blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman said Friday that a co-accused of former Speaker Martin Romualdez in his P7.44-billion plunder case has surrendered to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Thursday. In a statement, the Ombudsman announced the surrender of Felicito Guevarra, president of Samchan Foreign Exchange Corp. and a co-accused of […]...
